metaDescription: Kevin launches theaicults.com, a site profiling seven AI-related ideologies, and explains why he sees them as a new kind of cult building a god.
summary: Kevin introduces theaicults.com, a free site with pages on seven AI-related ideologies, a reference library, glossary, timelines, and mind maps. He argues that Silicon Valley figures are building something like a deity and that, despite feuding, the ideologies share an acceptance that most people will die so humanity can evolve. Kevin discusses Ray Kurzweil's "not yet" remark about God, links faith in institutions at a low to interest in an AI god, and says marketing gets people to want implants. He also says Israel and Unit 8200 connections run through these networks, naming figures including Peter Thiel and Palmer Luckey.

keyMoments.label: Building A God: AI As Religion
Why Most Of Us Must Die
